_about: The catalog: every thing the player can own, with its picture, its price and at most one effect. `key` is needed by an exit; a pill pays `progress` on use from a capped table; `wear` puts it on Yinyue (with a `lift`: her card's atk or hp by 1, or her 疗伤 by 0.1) or the abode; `charm` is a 符 — one in the bag is its card (cards.json, the same id) in hand at a fight's door, spent when it is played. Arms are the fight's own: a weapon's `atk` (器攻) with the `root` it lends, a 法衣's `def` (防), a 佩's `ward` (抗, by element) — each worn in its own slot, and each turned into the fight's numbers at the door by the rates in cards.json `gear` (器攻 → 主灵根一击, 防 → 护体, 抗 → that element lands lighter; the root lent lets its 功法 into the deck). `temper` feeds a 本命法宝 that many points of growth, and `core` on such a material names the element it would lend if the treasure were bound with it. `sold` names the provinces whose market shelves it; an item sold nowhere is a gift or a drop only. `pouch` on a 储物袋 adds that many slots to the bag's room for good, once for each kind (rewards.json `pouch`).

about.zh: 山中所生，灵兽所喜。
about.en: Grows in the hills; spirit beasts love it.

about.zh: 一粒抵半日打坐。
about.en: One pill is worth half a day's sitting.

about.zh: 形如人，年久者有灵。
about.en: Shaped like a person; an old one has a spirit of its own.

about.zh: 练气者的第一把剑，斩不了妖，斩得了心。佩之借木。
about.en: A first sword: it cuts no demon, only doubt. Worn, it lends 木.

about.zh: 泗水多雨。编得厚实，挡得住一拳。
about.en: It rains often on the Si. Woven thick, it turns a blow.

about.zh: 沉鼎观弟子的粗布袍，入门那天发的。
about.en: The coarse robe of a Chending Temple disciple, given on the day of entry.

about.zh: 渡叔塞给你的一袋干饼，硬得能砸核桃。
about.en: A bag of flat cakes Du Shu pressed on you, hard enough to crack walnuts.

about.zh: 汉墓里出来的东西，握着微温。
about.en: Something from a Han tomb; faintly warm in the hand.

about.zh: 船家只认牌，不认人。
about.en: The boatman knows the token, not the face.

about.zh: 系在银月颈上，走路便有声。
about.en: Tied at Yinyue's neck, it rings as she walks.

about.zh: 邺城铁匠打的，燕赵的样式。佩之借金。
about.en: Forged in Ye, in the style of Yan and Zhao. Worn, it lends 金.

about.zh: 练气圆满者服之，事半功倍。
about.en: For one at the peak of Qi Condensation: twice the work for half the effort.

items._furnace: Made in 银月's furnace (古九): 饭桶 sniffed the sect's 一转 官丹 once and made three from the garden's culls and 小狰's two old ginseng. The breakthrough reaches for it before the 一转 (ladder.json breakthrough.pill); not sold.

about.zh: 饭桶一炉出的筑基丹，透亮得像一滴凝住的露水，九道金纹，一丝黑斑也没有。沉鼎观三百年最好的一炉是三转。
about.en: A foundation pill from the rice-tub furnace: clear as a drop of frozen dew, nine gold rings, not one dark fleck. The best batch the temple made in three hundred years was three-turn.

about.zh: 筑基者服之，根基愈固，结丹之路愈近。
about.en: For one who has laid the Foundation: the base grows firmer, the Core comes nearer.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-15, from the description.

about.zh: 结丹以后破境时带在身上，雷落下来多一分把握。破境时化去。
about.en: Carried into a breakthrough from the Core on, it steadies you under the lightning. It is spent in the attempt.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-28, seed 2809, 640×480: a cracked vermilion pill on a celadon dish, lightning inside it, thunder clouds.

about.zh: 旧时疗伤的丹，如今只剩市价。
about.en: A healing pill of older days; now worth only its price.

items._furnace: Made in 银月's furnace (story/jiuding-lu/DESIGN.md § 丹药等级 — 随主人: the owner's realm, 九转): its own item, never the market's 回春丹. `zhuan` draws its nine gold lines; not sold, and worth nothing at a counter (九转丹不能卖).

about.zh: 小铜炉里出来的回春丹。药铺柜台上的是一转，一道纹；它九道，金的。骨伤也治得好，修为也跟着涨一截。拿出去卖，没人认得——认得的，更坏。
about.en: A mending pill out of the little furnace. The one on the shop counter is one-turn, one ring; this has nine, in gold. It mends even broken bone, and your cultivation climbs with it. Nobody would know it at a counter — and whoever did would be worse.

items._furnace: Made in 银月's furnace from the garden's culls (xu-yaoyuan-canzhu): 九转, three times the market 聚气丹's 修为; not sold.

about.zh: 残株炼的聚气丹，出炉九道金纹。坊市的聚气丹抵半日打坐；它抵三日。
about.en: A qi-gathering pill from the garden's culls, nine gold rings on it. The market's is worth half a day's sitting; this, three days.

about.zh: 观妖之气，知其将攻将守。筑基可习。
about.en: Read a beast's qi: whether it means to strike or to hold. From the Foundation.

about.zh: 气之所向，一招一式皆可见。结丹可习，须先通上卷。
about.en: Where its qi goes, every move is seen. From the Core, after Part One.

about.zh: 濮阳桑门的纸，写符最好。
about.en: Paper from Puyang's Mulberry Gate; the best for writing talismans.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-15, from the description.

about.zh: 齐有渔盐之利。海边晒出来的盐，雪一样白。
about.en: Qi's wealth is fish and salt: sea salt dried on the shore, white as snow.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-16, from the description.

about.zh: 齐纨鲁缟，天下第一。披在银月肩上。
about.en: The silk of Qi, the finest under heaven; laid over Yinyue's shoulders.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-16, from the description.

about.zh: 桑皮纸上朱砂一道。降妖时在手，掷出打三点，不论五行；一符一用。
about.en: One stroke of cinnabar on mulberry paper. In hand when you fight: cast, it strikes for 3 whatever the root; one use each.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-16, from the description.

about.zh: 银月从尾巴尖上拔下一根银毛，丢进饭桶，「本王给你开个张」——飘出来一张黄纸：朱砂画的一匹马，脑袋大，身子小，四条腿像四根筷子插在一个馒头上。你骂了一句「这踏马的，是什么符？」，它便叫了这个名字。不知何用，叠成小方块，跟含笑半步颠塞在腰带夹层里。斗法时在手：打出去，一跳躲开一回杀招，落点不由人，落在蛫背上。只灵一回，用完成一撮黄灰。
about.en: Yinyue plucked one silver hair from the tip of her tail and dropped it into the Rice Tub — "Let this king open shop for you" — and out floated a slip of yellow paper: a horse in cinnabar, big head, small body, four legs like four chopsticks stuck in a steamed bun. You swore at it — "What the hoof is this charm?" — and the name stuck. You had no idea what it was for; you folded it small and tucked it into your belt fold beside the Smiling Half-Step Topple. In hand when you fight: play it and one leap clears a killing blow; where you land is not yours to choose — onto the gui's back. Good once; used, it is a pinch of yellow ash.

items._about: 古四 (the author, 2026-10-02): the 饭桶 spat it out for one of 银月's tail hairs; he never tried it, kept it in his belt fold, and slapped it on blind in 古五 (「这个用完就没了，留在秘境里用。」). One use, never sold; granted on the way to the 困阵 (wm-wangzuo open). Its card (cards.json tama-fu) summons the 蛫 as a 护主 — the existing answer to a 杀招 (battle.js § gather: the blow takes the guard first), which is the book's leap: the four fire snakes hit the shell (「是可以禦火」).
items.art_source: The talisman's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-16) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 山骨之精，千年始凝。
about.en: The mountain's own bone, a thousand years in the setting.

about.zh: 为雷所击而不死之木，纹里带火。
about.en: Wood the lightning struck and did not kill; the grain still carries fire.

about.zh: 触之如冰，暑月不温。
about.en: Cold to the hand, and no summer warms it.

about.zh: 地火烧尽余下的一点，落水不熄。
about.en: What is left when the earth-fire burns out; water does not put it out.

about.zh: 鲧窃帝之息壤以堙洪水——取之一掬，自生不已。
about.en: The soil Gun stole from the Emperor to dam the flood: a handful of it grows and does not stop.

about.zh: 寻常妖兽腹中所结，暖如活物。
about.en: Formed in an ordinary beast's belly; it is warm, like something living.

about.zh: 气已凝而不散，握之微微跳。
about.en: The breath in it holds together now; it beats faintly in the hand.

about.zh: 内有一线光行走不停。
about.en: A thread of light walks inside it and never stops.

about.zh: 缺口的环，古人佩以决事。土气厚，挡得住土行法术。
about.en: A ring with a gap, worn by the ancients when a thing had to be decided. Its earth is thick enough to turn an earth spell.

about.zh: 扬州厥包橘柚。淮南的橘，过了淮就成了枳。
about.en: Yang sent oranges and pomelos in baskets as tribute. An orange of the south turns bitter north of the Huai.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-24, from the description.

about.zh: 荆州贡丹。红得像火，炼丹的人离不开它。
about.en: Jing sent cinnabar as tribute. Red as fire; no alchemist can do without it.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-24, from the description.

about.zh: 蜀地的锦，要在锦江里洗，颜色才鲜。
about.en: The brocade of Shu; washed in the Brocade River its colours come up bright, and in any other river they dull.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-24, from the description.

about.zh: 雍州厥贡球、琳、琅玕。琅玕是青绿色的美石，圆得像珠子。
about.en: Yong's tribute was qiu and lin jade and langgan — a blue-green stone, round as pearls.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-24, from the description.

about.zh: 靛青绸面，绣着云纹。换上它，储物袋多出十二格。
about.en: Indigo silk worked with clouds. Carry it and your pouch holds twelve more kinds.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-25, from the description.

about.zh: 绛红织锦，玉扣系口，袋里自成一方天地。换上它，储物袋多出二十四格。
about.en: Crimson brocade with a jade toggle; a small world inside. Carry it and your pouch holds twenty-four more kinds.

items.art_source: Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-25, from the description.

about.zh: 吴婆婆塞给你的小木牌，磨得发亮；刻着一只蜷着的狐狸，尾巴绕着身子——九条。银月睡在里头：一条尾巴亮着，银的，一明，一暗。
about.en: The little wooden token Granny Wu pressed into your hand, worn bright; carved with a curled fox, its tails wrapped round it — nine. Yinyue sleeps inside: one tail is lit, silver, bright then dim.

about.zh: 黑松岭那头雄鹿的皮，完整，油光水滑——够交马家的租。
about.en: The hide of the stag from Black Pine Ridge, whole and glossy — enough for the Mas' rent.

about.zh: 弓背裂过两回，拿牛筋缠着。爹摘下来放在你面前：「你拿着。」佩之借木。
about.en: Its back cracked twice and bound with ox sinew. Father took it off the wall and laid it before you: "Take it." Worn, it lends 木.

about.zh: 凡铁，刀口缺了两个牙，后来又缺了一个。秘境干河床上，从一个死人手里一根一根掰开指头拿下来的。猎户放血，就使这么一把。
about.en: Common iron, two nicks in the edge, and later a third. Taken in the hidden realm's dry riverbed from a dead man's hand, one stiff finger at a time. A hunter bleeds a deer with a knife like this.

items._about: 古五: picked up, not given (the author, 2026-10-02: 「在秘境中捡一把武器吧」). The lowest blade there is: 器攻 1.
items.art_source: The iron sword's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B)) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 只长在站过鼎的地方：鼎在那里站了上千年，地面泡透了鼎气，长出一层青得发黑的苔。筑基丹的主药；生吃，筑基多一分把握。天下只有鼎址才有。
about.en: It grows only where a cauldron once stood: a thousand years of standing soaks the ground with the cauldron's breath, and a moss comes up so green it is nearly black. The chief herb of the Foundation pill; eaten raw, it steadies a Foundation breakthrough a little. Only a cauldron's old footing grows it.

items._about: 古五 (the author, 2026-10-02): the 秘境's own — round the four 七拃 pits in the stone chamber, and in the cracks of the dry riverbed below the wind shaft, where the cauldron's breath seeped down. Every one of the nine cauldrons' old footings will have it (OUTLINE 扣子簿). No effect of its own: carried into the Foundation breakthrough it is the last thing reached for (ladder.json breakthrough.pill), a small bonus.
items.art_source: The lingzhi's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B)) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 秦始皇派人在泗水捞鼎，水里钻出一条龙，咬断了绳子，崩掉几根龙须，落在河底扎了根。须子又长又硬，泛一点金。只长在泗水底下。吃下去，冲得开经脉。
about.en: When the First Emperor's men fished the Si for the cauldron, a dragon rose and bit the rope through, and a few whiskers snapped off, sank, and took root in the riverbed. Long, stiff blades with a gleam of gold. It grows only under the Si. Eaten, it forces the meridians open.

items._about: 古五 (the author, 2026-10-02; 《史记·封禅书》「龙髯拔，堕」, 鲁泥鳅's rope): only in the 秘境's dry riverbed, bared the year the Si fell lowest. 冲开经脉 → 修为, the 筑基丹's own table (task).
items.art_source: The ginseng's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B)) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 秘境十年翻一回身，吸一口气；那口气在最深处凝成珠子，指甲盖大，攥在手心里一跳一跳，像攥着一颗心。跟息壤同出一源。吞一颗，修为涨一截。
about.en: Once in ten years the hidden realm turns over and draws one breath; in its deepest place that breath sets into a bead the size of a fingernail, which beats in the palm like a held heart. Of one source with the breathing soil. Swallow one, and your cultivation climbs a stretch.

items._about: 古五 (the author, 2026-10-02): 「河底下有东西在呼吸」 made a thing — 冯九 shows one at the door (「息珠。十年一口气，就凝这么几粒」). The 九转回春丹's table (scene).
items.art_source: The langgan's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B), 2026-09-24) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 秘境干河床崖壁上的一道铜矿，往年淹在水底下。九鼎是收九州之铜铸的。
about.en: From a copper vein in the wall of the hidden realm's dry riverbed, under water in other years. The nine cauldrons were cast from the copper of the nine provinces.

items._about: 古五 (the author, 2026-10-02): the year's low water bared a copper vein; 孙二狗 dug half a lump with his fingernails. A find at shimen (meets.json).
items.art_source: The true gold's picture (Painted for Lingjing by the local picture model (FLUX.2 klein 4B)) until its own is painted.

about.zh: 银月留下的一卷残简，绳子都快烂了。「看不懂，也要背。背熟了，总有一天会懂。」
about.en: The scroll Yinyue left, its cords nearly rotted through. "Learn it by heart even if you can't understand it. One day you will."

about.zh: 伙房的萝卜，白的，带着泥。银月说：带根萝卜去。
about.en: A radish from the kitchen, white, with the soil still on. Yinyue said: take a radish.

about.zh: 银月从仙界带下来的丹炉，巴掌大，三足两耳，炉盖上蹲着一只小兽。它炼丹不炸。它嘴刁。
about.en: The furnace Yinyue brought down from the heavens: palm-sized, three legs, two ears, a little beast crouched on the lid. It never blows up a batch. It is a picky eater.

about.zh: 瞿老扔给你的一卷薄书。「上有黄庭下关元，后有幽阙前命门」——三丹田，这回自己练。
about.en: A thin book Elder Qu tossed you. "Above is the Yellow Court, below the Origin Pass; behind the Hidden Gate, before the Gate of Life" — the three elixir fields, yours to train now.

about.zh: 沉鼎观祖师留下的半卷竹简。三百年，没有一个人练成过第一宫——它要五行俱全。开篇是：戴九履一，左三右七。
about.en: Half a bamboo scroll left by the temple's founder. In three hundred years no one has mastered its first palace — it needs all five elements. It opens: nine on the head, one on the feet, three on the left, seven on the right.
